editorial:
Imagine being stuck in prison for twenty years with your health fading fast. That is where you find Ida Red, a tough woman who knows her time is running out. She reaches out to her son, Wyatt, who has spent his life trying to stay away from the crime world his mother loved. You get a gritty, tense feeling right from the start as Ida convinces her son to pull off one last big heist to buy her freedom. It is a story about family bonds, betrayal, and the desperation that comes when you have nothing left to lose.

You will really enjoy the chemistry between the leads and the way the tension builds up during the robbery scenes. The pacing is quick, though some of the plot twists might feel a bit predictable if you watch a lot of crime films. Still, it is a solid ride that keeps you guessing. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those crisp visuals, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick for a weekend binge.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a huge betrayal. You find out that the heist was not just about money, but about a deep-seated grudge. Ida ends up manipulating the situation to ensure she gets what she wants, even if it means sacrificing others. In the final scenes, the cycle of crime continues as Wyatt realizes his mother will always be a criminal at heart. The story ends with a bittersweet feeling of freedom bought with blood.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies and stories about complicated parents.
